hook.name: SatoHook
hook.description: A bonding curve hook for an ETH/SATO token pair that fully replaces the AMM; buys mint SATO via a forward curve and sells burn SATO via an inverse curve, with a 0.3% fee. Includes per-wallet cooldown by block number, entropy-based multipliers in the first 100 blocks, and automatic self-deprecation when fair-curve supply nears the 21M cap.
